<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Restaurant" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/restaurant">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_RestaurantOrder" name="Restaurant Order and Meal Pickup" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Roles">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Guest" name="Guest">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Hungry</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChooseDish</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WaitForTurn</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_GuestAtHatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EatMeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_MealEaten</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectPayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetUpBuzzer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InformChef</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InformedMealReady</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetOffBuzzer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Merge_Call</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Wait_Reaction</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Timer_FiveMinutes</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CallGuest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_HandOverMeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Chef" name="Chef">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareMeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceMealInHatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Hungry" name="Guest feels hungry and enters restaurant"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseDish" name="Choose dish from changing meal range"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WaitForTurn" name="Wait until it is his turn"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order with employee"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterOrder" name="Enter order into POS system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectPayment" name="Collect payment from guest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SetUpBuzzer" name="Set up buzzer and hand it to guest with information: When the buzzer rings, your dinner is ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InformChef" name="Inform chef of new meal order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareMeal" name="Prepare meal"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceMealInHatch" name="Place finished meal in service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InformedMealReady" name="Inform employee that meal is in service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SetOffBuzzer" name="Set off guest's buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Merge_Call" name="Merge"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_Wait_Reaction" name="Guest reacts to buzzer?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_GuestAtHatch" name="Guest appears at service hatch">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageDef_GuestAtHatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Timer_FiveMinutes" name="5 minutes without reaction">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDef_FiveMinutes">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">PT5M</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CallGuest" name="Call for guest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HandOverMeal" name="Hand over meal to guest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EatMeal" name="Eat meal"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MealEaten" name="Guest has eaten meal"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Hungry" targetRef="Task_ChooseDish"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_ChooseDish" targetRef="Task_WaitForTurn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_WaitForTurn" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_EnterOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_EnterOrder" targetRef="Task_CollectPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_CollectPayment" targetRef="Task_SetUpBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_SetUpBuzzer" targetRef="Task_InformChef"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_InformChef" targetRef="Task_PrepareMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_PrepareMeal" targetRef="Task_PlaceMealInHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_PlaceMealInHatch" targetRef="Task_InformedMealReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_InformedMealReady" targetRef="Task_SetOffBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_SetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Call"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_Merge_Call" targetRef="Gateway_Wait_Reaction"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_Wait_Reaction" targetRef="Event_GuestAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_Wait_Reaction" targetRef="Timer_FiveMinutes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Timer_FiveMinutes" targetRef="Task_CallGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_CallGuest" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Call"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Event_GuestAtHatch" targetRef="Task_HandOverMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_HandOverMeal" targetRef="Task_EatMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_EatMeal" targetRef="EndEvent_MealEaten"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
